plain: People moving into a country to live there for good

webster.text: The passing or removing into a country for the purpose of permanent residence.

example.quote: Credit being restored, and confidence diffused in the country, merchants and men of wealth will be induced to come among us, immigration will increase, and commerce will flourish ; the impost will therefore be more sure and productive.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
